Three setup jobs came back passed, and their results are now in the setup record. R01: the parent's own map and bimap tests pass (120,694, 0 failures), and the fix's five test files give 15 failures on a copy of the parent, all the new throwing-callback assertions. The record now also has the parent jar digests, the classpaths (every entry checked to exist) and the summary rows. 47 of the 50 cases are now checked at both pins on a JVM.

R50 (JUnit #4466) was not verified, although its job reported passed. All three offline builds stopped at :jupiter-tests:compileTestGroovy, because 13 Groovy 4.0.26 modules that GroovyCompile infers at compile time were missing from the Gradle cache, and the job script exited 0 whatever happened. An init script in the setup cache now resolves that classpath. All 47 Groovy 4.0.26 files equal Maven Central's .sha1, and they resolve offline at both pins. The JUnit job script now fails a step whose outcome is wrong.

Job 20261126-180537-setup-rerun-junit-4466-r50-at-both-pins reruns R50's fix, parent and landed tests.
